parsedVerdict.reasoning: This file is an ordinary application-layer use case. Its execute() method takes a DTO, builds a domain Project entity and saves it through the ProjectRepository interface, which is a domain port injected via the constructor. It contains no persistence code, HTTP or framework handling, or presentation logic. It doesn't put rules on the entity's own state either, since it just passes dto.name and dto.description to the Project constructor. The private generateId() helper uses Date.now() and Math.random(). One could argue ID generation belongs behind an infrastructure port, but making an ID during orchestration is acceptable for an application layer, so I don't count it as a responsibility from another layer kind.
